outputs.explanation: This is a stacked area/bar chart showing median promoter-state frequencies across a continuum of Pol II ChIP-seq bins (n=5912 promoters aggregated into many bins, 6 stacked states). Functionally this behaves like a line/trend plot across a continuous binned x-axis rather than a simple discrete bar chart of group means; overlaying thousands of individual promoter values across all bins and stacked categories would make the plot unreadable, so it falls under the line-plot type exemption.

This panel is a single-molecule stack where each row already represents an individual DNA molecule's methylation pattern (2952 molecules shown), so the individual data points underlying the adjacent state-frequency sidebar summary are directly displayed within the same panel.

Same representation as panel A (mouse data, n=6122 promoters) — a continuous stacked area/bar chart across binned Pol II ChIP-seq levels, which behaves like a trend/line plot; overlaying individual points is impractical and falls under the exemption.

Same representation as panel B (mouse Skp1 locus) — each row is an individual molecule (2871 molecules), so individual data points underlying the state-frequency summary are shown directly in the panel.
Box plots of PIC occupancy show individual data points (dots) overlaid on the boxplots for each group, in addition to the median/IQR summary.
Box plots of Pol II occupancy show individual data points (dots) overlaid on the boxplots for each group, in addition to the median/IQR summary.
